input: A catalog action id from any input device, with an optional value (frame, channel), target (marker, slot, cover) and the panel the pointer was on.
output: One system action the panel router takes, the same for the keyboard, the mouse and future devices (touchpad, gestures, programmable keyboard, edit console).
specification: User 2026-10-18: every action under a system code so that many input devices can drive QNC through their own maps; each device is a block.
